port.name: zellij
port.description: Living Code for zellij. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.installation:
These use zellij's component-based [theme format](https://zellij.dev/documentation/themes.html), so they need a zellij release that supports it. Download the themes into the `themes` folder of your config directory, then name one in `config.kdl`:

```sh
curl -fsSL --create-dirs --output-dir ~/.config/zellij/themes -O "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/living-code-theme/zellij/main/living-code-{night,frost,paper,signal}.kdl"
```

```kdl
theme "living-code-night"
```

`zellij setup --check` prints the exact config directory if yours is elsewhere.
guide.configuration: See [zellij's documentation](https://zellij.dev) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: This port supplies theme files for zellij, not the application itself. Install the application separately and follow the installation instructions for its supported configuration format.
